topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: In addition, these funds may have limited performance histories. It may not be clear how they will perform under different market conditions.
answer: Smart beta, quant, and other non-traditional index funds can be complex because their custom indexes may use methods that are difficult to understand, such as quantitative analysis or algorithms involving complicated calculations. They may also have limited performance histories, so it may be unclear how they will perform in different market conditions. A strategy’s goal of outperforming the market does not mean it will necessarily do so.
